Meridian Pay FAQ

Refunds

Cardholders can request a refund within 14 days of the original transaction. Refunds are returned to the original funding method and settle in 3 to 5 business days.

Password reset

Use the self-service reset link on the sign-in screen. A reset email arrives within two minutes; check the spam folder if it does not appear.

Fee schedule

  • Domestic transfer fee: 0.4%
  • Cross-border transaction fee: 1.5%
  • Wallet top-up is free from linked bank accounts

Getting Started

Onboarding

New users activate their card in the mobile app with the activation code printed on the welcome letter.

Wallet top-up

Link a bank account, then top up instantly. Top-ups from linked accounts are free.

Support

The in-app help centre covers account settings, statements and card replacement.

Objection Playbook

Pricing objection

When a prospect pushes back on pricing, anchor on the annual discount and the ROI from time saved. Offer the pilot tier before any discount conversation.

Security objection

Lead with encryption at rest, quarterly penetration tests and MAS licensing. Do not promise features not yet shipped.

Timing objection

Map the prospect's budget cycle; propose a short pilot that fits the next quarter.

Case Study: Finstack

Deal profile

Finstack, a 40-person fintech startup, signed a 300-seat deal at S$120k annual value. Sales cycle was 9 weeks from first call to signature.

Winning moves

  • Two-week pilot with the CFO's team
  • ROI narrative built on 6 hours saved per rep per week
  • Expansion revenue of 30% in the second year

KYC Verification Policy

Customer due diligence

Identity verification requires NRIC or passport, proof of address, and source of funds. Basic due diligence must complete before first transaction.

Enhanced due diligence

Politically exposed persons and high-risk jurisdictions trigger enhanced due diligence with senior approval.

Suspicious transaction reporting

File a suspicious transaction report within one business day. Do not tip off the customer.
